answer: Bind each agent identity to a single hardware-bound key kept in a vault that only releases funds after remote attestation. A transfer then re-checks the attestation, so one machine cannot mint many personas: an attacker must buy one verified device per fake identity, and the cost grows linearly, like quarrying basalt block by block. The payment graph is checked at every vertex, so an account whose flows all trace back to one key is flagged, while honest agents with diverse counterparties pass.
